## Source verification semantics

`REPO_ONLY` validates registry/schema/coverage references and deliberately does not claim workstation files are present. `LOCAL_SOURCE_VERIFICATION` requires `--source-root`, locates exact filenames below that root, computes SHA-256 and supported PDF page counts, and records portable IDs/results in `research/data/source_verification.json` without absolute paths.
